label: Charts
description: Data-viz templates with animatable bars, lines, rings and counters.

items.name: Vertical bar chart
items.description: Six columns (#bar-1..6, each with <text id="val-n"> and "cat-n"). Grow bars with scaleY 0 to 1 (transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: bottom), staggered 0.06s, and count the values up. Set real heights by editing each bar's y/height.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Horizontal bar chart
items.description: Five ranked rows: <text id="label-n">, #bar-n (grow scaleX from the left: transform-origin left), <text id="val-n">. Ideal for 'us vs them' rankings with the brand's row in --accent.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Line chart with area
items.description: Growth line: #line (draw-on dash) over #area (gradient fill), points .dot (#dot-1..8), end label <text id="end-value">. Draw #line left to right (0.8-1.2s), fade #area in behind it, pop the last dot and value.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Donut chart
items.description: Four-segment donut (#seg-1..4, each a circle with pathLength=100: its share is the dash length) and a center <text id="center-value">. Sweep each segment on by tweening stroke-dasharray from '0 100' to 'share 100' in sequence.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Progress ring
items.description: Radial progress: #track and #arc (pathLength=100, currently 75). Tween #arc stroke-dasharray from '0 100' to 'N 100' while counting <text id="value"> up to N.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Speed gauge
items.description: Half-circle gauge with three zones and a needle (#needle, pivot at 320,340). Rotate #needle from -90 to the value's angle (+90 = max) with a short overshoot; count <text id="value"> in sync.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Sparkline
items.description: Compact trend line (#line, draw-on) with an end dot (#end). Sits next to a KPI number.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Stat card
items.description: Big-number card: <text id="value">, "label", trend chip (#trend with <text id="trend-value">). Count #value up (snap to whole numbers) and pop #trend after it lands.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Trend up badge
items.description: Pill badge with <text id="value">▲ +24%</text>. Pop it beside a number after the count-up lands.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Trend down badge
items.description: Pill badge with <text id="value">▼ −12%</text>. Pop it beside a number after the count-up lands.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Funnel
items.description: Four-stage funnel (#stage-1..4 with <text id="stage-label-n">). Drop stages in from the top, 0.08s apart.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Before / after bars
items.description: Two bars (#before muted, #after --accent) with labels and values (<text id="before-value">, "after-value"). Grow #before first, then #after, so the difference is the punchline.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Timeline steps
items.description: Four milestones on a line: #track (draw-on), nodes #node-1..4, <text id="step-n"> titles. Draw the track left to right and pop each node as the line reaches it.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: KPI grid
items.description: 2x2 metric tiles (#tile-1..4 with <text id="kpi-value-n"> and "kpi-label-n"). Land tiles in a staggered grid order and count every value up.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Radar chart
items.description: Five-axis radar: grid pentagons, axis labels (<text id="axis-1..5">) and a data polygon #data. Scale #data from the center (transform-origin 320px 330px) 0 to 1.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Number counter frame
items.description: Huge number (<text id="value">) with a <text id="suffix"> and an underline (#rule, draw-on). Count #value up with a snapping ease, draw #rule when it lands.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use
